\section*{Data availability}
The code, the simulation outputs, the public-trial variance-component analyses, the meta-analysis extraction sheets and the scripts that generate every number, table and figure in this article are openly available on GitHub at \url{https://github.com/juksentang/bean-phenotyping-value} and archived on Zenodo at \url{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23197205}. The public trial datasets are available from their original repositories (Supplementary Section S3).
